Court Made The Following:
 Order

The subject petition calls in question the proceedings in C.C.No.849/2019 arising out of Crime No.240/2018 registered for the offences punishable under Sections 498A, 504, 506, 313 read with Section 34 of the Indian Penal Code and Sections 3 and 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961.

During the pendency of the petition, the parties were before the concerned Court in G & WC No.250/2018 wherein they have settled the issue and are leaving together by drawing up certain terms of settlement.
One such term is closure of the present proceedings in the light of a dispute between the couple settled.

The conditions reads as follows:

"We submit that we are aware of the facts and circumstances of the above petition and we are competent to swear to this affidavit;
We submit that, Smt. Bhuvaneshwari had filed a complaint against the Petitioners in Hanumantha Nagar Police Station, Benglauru in Crime No.240/2018 for the offence punishable under Sections 498-A, 504, 506, 313, 34 of Indian Penal Code and 3 & 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act.
The same is pending on the file of Hon'ble 24th Additional CMM Court, Nrupathunga Road, Bengaluru in C.C.No.849/2019.

entities.text: 24th Additional CMM Court, Nrupathunga Road, Bengaluru
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: We submit that, The PARTIES have come to a conclusion and resolve the entire disputes between them as per the compromise petition filed in G & WC.No.250/2018 before the VI Addl. Prl. Family Court at Bengaluru.

entities.text: VI Addl. Prl. Family Court at Bengaluru
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: As per the settlement petitioner No.1 and respondent No.2 reunion and respondent No.2 agreed to cooperate in closing/quashing the above said case.

WHEREFORE, it is humbly prayed that this Hon'ble Court be pleased to Quash the entire proceedings in C.C.No.849/2019 arising out of Crime No.240/2018 against the petitioners pending on the file of Hon'ble 24th Additional CMM Court, Nrupathunga Road, Bengaluru for the offence punishable under Sections 498-A, 504, 506, 313 read with 34 of Indian Penal Code and 3 & 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act.

entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
We the Deponents do hereby declare that what is stated above is true and correct to the best of our NC: 2023:KHC:19826 knowledge, belief and information and the signatures found in this affidavit are our own;"
3. In the light of a settlement arrived at between the parties and offences punishable as aforesaid, as also the fact that the couples are now staying together and have a child as well.
I deem it appropriate to accept the settlement and terminate the proceedings against the petitioners.
The criminal petition stands disposed of.
The proceedings in C.C.No.849/2019 stands quashed against the petitioners.
